items.title: Nico Collins: First TD since Week 4 on Sunday
items.text:
Collins corralled all four of his targets for 55 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 44-22 victory at the Chargers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Kittle: Four catches in Week 9 win
items.text:
Kittle caught four of seven targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Purdy: Three total TDs in Week 9 win
items.text:
Purdy completed 17 of 25 passes for 232 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders. He added seven rushing attempts for 40 yards and a touchdown.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Trey McBride: Notches at least seven catches again
items.text:
McBride recorded seven catches (on eight targets) for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 loss at Seattle.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Season low in receiving yards
items.text:
Smith-Njigba reeled in seven of 10 targets for 51 yards during Sunday's 17-3 win against the Cardinals.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Gets good news on Sunday's MRI
items.text:
Mahomes (elbow) underwent an MRI after Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets, and the tests did not reveal a major injury, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Tosses five touchdowns
items.text:
Stroud completed 21 of 35 passes for 384 yards, five touchdowns and one interception and recorded two carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 44-22 win at the Chargers.
